job.title: Change Manager
job.description:
About the Role
Are you an experienced Change Manager ready to lead meaningful change across cyber risk, third party risk and certification and accreditation processes? Our client, a large New Zealand organisation, is uplifting how it manages cyber risk, vendor risk and compliance certification.
This is a contract engagement, not a permanent position. It is also a stakeholder led, business side change role. You will not be configuring systems or writing code. You will be helping people, teams and processes adapt to new ways of working, starting with the Security Assurance, Security Services and Performance, and Privacy teams, and extending to further teams across the organisation over time.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and deliver end to end change management plans for the rollout of cyber risk, third party risk and certification and accreditation processes
  • Conduct stakeholder analysis, change impact assessments and readiness assessments for each team and process going live
  • Develop and execute communication, training and adoption plans tailored to technical security teams, business owners and vendor facing staff
  • Partner with risk, security and privacy teams to translate new workflows into clear, well structured standard operating procedures
  • Identify resistance points and process gaps, and implement mitigation and support plans
  • Support go live and post implementation activities to embed sustained adoption
  • Track and report on change readiness, adoption metrics and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain a central repository of change artefacts, standard operating procedures and training materials
What We're Looking For
  • 5 plus years' experience as a Business Change Manager or similar, delivering change for enterprise risk, security or compliance implementations
  • Experience within a government agency, large corporate, or regulated industry such as financial services, utilities or insurance is highly regarded
  • Demonstrated experience writing clear, detailed standard operating procedures and process documentation for non technical audiences
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across technical and non technical audiences
  • Experience managing change across multiple concurrent teams or workstreams
  • Familiarity with change methodologies such as Prosci or ADKAR
  • Available to start at short notice, contractors only
Advantageous
  • Experience within a cyber security, third party or vendor risk, or certification and accreditation environment
  • Familiarity with frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NCSC, NIST, HISF or NZISM
  • Exposure to governance, risk and compliance platforms covering third party risk management, risk management and compliance automation
How to Apply
If you are an experienced contract Change Manager with a background in risk, security or compliance change, and can start at short notice, apply now and we will aim to get in touch quickly given the need to fill this role at short notice.

job.title: Programme Delivery Lead
job.description:
• Length: 6-month contract
  • Banking Sector
  • Location: Wellington

About the Role
Our client in the banking sector is well into a multi-year core technology transformation and needs an experienced Technical Programme Delivery Lead to lead technical delivery.
The programme has recently reorganised around three product workstreams that own the end-to-end journey through build, migrate and sell, alongside an enablement workstream.

This is complex, high-pace delivery with minimal onboarding. You will need to bring structure and pace from week one.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead technical delivery across the product and enablement workstreams
  • Coordinate tight sequencing across multiple dependent technical domains
  • Maintain a clear, accurate view of true delivery status, not reported status
  • Work in the detail with domain leads to test and strengthen their delivery plans
  • Improve delivery flow, governance and decision-making inside an established model, practically and constructively
  • Surface the risks and dependencies others miss, early enough to act on them
  • Represent the programme at executive level and across programme forums
  • Keep the why, the critical dates and the key messages front of mind for delivery teams
What We're Looking For
  • Proven experience at a programme level delivering complex, multi-workstream technology programmes
  • Strong technical software delivery background, with genuine depth in integration projects and the ability to hold your own in technical detail with domain leads
  • Hands-on exposure to event-driven architecture and integration platforms
  • Deep banking or financial services experience, ideally on core system transformation
  • Strong executive-level stakeholder communication and programme forum representation
  • Ability to build context fast and add value with minimal ramp-up
  • A practical, "how can we" approach to problem-solving
  • Experience across transformation programmes with multiple delivery partners or vendors (advantageous)
  • Cloud-based delivery environments (advantageous)
How to Apply
If you are a Programme Delivery Lead with strong integration delivery and banking experience, apply online today and we will be in touch with shortlisted candidates.

job.title: NSX Architect
job.description:
VMware NSX Architect

  • Length: 3 month initial term, with high likelihood of extension of 9 months or more following this
  • Project: Enterprise-Scale Cloud & Infrastructure Transformation
  • Location: Open to candidates based across NZ
  • Working Arrangement: Hybrid
  • Rate: Market Rate
Are you a VMware NSX Architect ready to lead network and security design on a large-scale enterprise infrastructure transformation? Our client is undertaking a major multi-year modernisation programme, migrating thousands of servers onto a new cloud platform, and needs an experienced architect to design the software-defined networking and micro-segmentation foundations before the migration wave begins in earnest.

This is a rare opportunity to shape the target-state network architecture for an enterprise-scale environment from the ground up, working at the intersection of cloud platform strategy, security, and infrastructure modernisation.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and lead the implementation of VMware NSX architecture across a large-scale, multi-thousand-server environment.
  • Define micro-segmentation, security zoning, and connectivity patterns to underpin a modern, resilient cloud platform.
  • Partner with cloud platform and implementation teams to ensure network design aligns with broader migration and modernisation timelines.
  • Provide technical leadership on software-defined networking best practice, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, and future-proofed.
  • Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and delivery stakeholders to embed the architecture into the wider transformation programme.
  • Produce architecture documentation, standards, and design artefacts to guide implementation partners.
What We're Looking For
  • Proven experience as an NSX Architect or Senior Network Architect on enterprise-scale infrastructure or cloud transformation programmes.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with VMware NSX, including micro-segmentation and software-defined networking design.
  • Track record designing network architecture for large, complex, multi-site or multi-thousand-server environments.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platform migration and modernisation programmes (public and private cloud).
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work across security, infrastructure, and delivery teams.
  • Experience in regulated or high-governance environments (advantageous).
How to Apply
If you're an NSX Architect with enterprise-scale transformation experience, apply now. We'll be in touch with shortlisted candidates.
